origins.section: Class.forName(name) Runs the Static Initialiser; the Three-Argument Form Waits for First Use
Class.newInstance Lets the Constructor's Checked Exception Escape Undeclared
A Method Handle Has a Type, and invokeExact Holds the Call Site to It
A Class Named in Configuration Fails at First Use, Unless Startup Resolves It

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-scan-static-env: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scan-static-env: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-scan-static-env: Page L126-127: 'Class.forName(name) is forName(name, true, callerLoader): it loads the class and initialises it'; output L119-123 shows ExceptionInInitializerError on first forName, then NoClassDefFoundError: Could not initialize class; L131-132: 'A failed initialiser is not retried ... every later use in that JVM throws NoClassDefFoundError'. Scan catches Throwable, so it logs EIIE; later new gets NCDFE. Reference table L279-280 confirms.
recorded.prompt:q-job-runner-sqlexception: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-job-runner-sqlexception: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-job-runner-sqlexception: L174-177: 'Class.newInstance declares only InstantiationException and IllegalAccessException, and rethrows the constructor's exception as it is. The IOException ... passed the catch and ended main'; output L163-169. Reference L277: 'rethrown as is, checked or not'.
recorded.prompt:q-thumbnail-invokeexact: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-thumbnail-invokeexact: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-thumbnail-invokeexact: L236-240: invokeExact is signature-polymorphic, javac 'checks nothing'; at run time the call site type 'must equal the handle's, with no widening, boxing or upcasting. Without the cast the call site's return type is Object ... and it fails the same way' (WrongMethodTypeException, L230-232).
recorded.prompt:q-notifier-config: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-notifier-config: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-notifier-config: L75-78: the cast '(Class<? extends Exporter>) Class.forName(name, false, loader) compiles with an unchecked warning and checks nothing, because generics are erased: ReportJob would pass startup and fail with a ClassCastException at the line that takes its first instance as an Exporter, before any Exporter method is called'. Reference L286.
